All sourcing and procurement needs to be done against the backdrop of JLL governance and S&P guidelines.

Global Category Manager – Software

Develop, manage and execute global category sourcing strategies within the specific IT Category allocated. As the Software Category Manager you will be responsible for building relationships with the CIO’s, CTO’s, Chief Product Officers, building internal demand plans, developing category plans including new opportunities and manage relationships with key strategic suppliers. Ensure contracting and procurement standards are maintained throughout the portfolio.

Summary of essential functions and Goals

  • Partner with the JLLT leadership team to create category strategies that align with JLLT’s key fundamental plans whilst leveraging growing expenditure to have commercial advantage

  • Develops & regularly maintains/up‑dates short-, mid- and long‑term category strategy globally, linking this strategy with overall business strategy/objectives, in alignment with departmental stakeholders (C‑suite)

  • Category Manager has and/or forges key strategic relationships with (strategic) suppliers/industry leaders and develops those relationships on behalf of JLL being mindful of long‑term mutually beneficial and ethical objectives as well as providing the business with access to supplier innovation

  • Category Manager is responsible for leading the approval process for third party expenditure. This includes presenting the deal to senior leaders in the business such as the JLLT CEO, Global CFO and Global CPO

  • Category Manager is leading key strategic procurement projects and provides expert advice and guidance to the JLLT leadership team. Advice has expanded from pricing and commercial principles to incorporate aligning supplier/partner strategies to make/buy decisions & managing sensitivities where JLL’s strategy could create direct conflict against the suppliers value proposition

  • The Category Manager will recommend the qualification of appropriate service providers/supply partners to ensure that we have the best service provision available across the region to deliver value to our internal and sometimes also external clients

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for global category strategy development, execution and category performance of all category related activities & objectives for corporate category requirements as well as other JLL entities if required. Ensuring alignment across the JLLT Leadership team

  • Delivery of financial targets in line with business expectations. Category Manager continuously drives the category opportunity agenda and self‑sufficiently identifies, agrees and executes these projects

  • Accountable for creating strategic solution for specific commodity/service requirements, procurement event planning, RFP/quotation management, bid analysis and recommendations, liaison with internal stakeholders for contract approvals, savings reporting, documentation and compliance.

  • Create and manage the category project calendar, lead category events, bid process, commercial evaluation, recommendations, contract document preparation and functional reviews

  • Approvals according to JLL Delegation of Authority. Compliance with JLL procedures as applicable. This includes presenting and seeking approval from Global CEO of JLLT, Global CPO and Global CFO

  • Rationalizes supply base and develops clear strategic supply partner framework and maintains this framework at senior supplier level

  • Use Global, Regional and Country, market and industry intelligence to identify and qualify new suppliers and use data to support the business and delivery of services. In addition, identify risk, threats and provide solutions for mitigation.

  • Provide functional leadership and peer group alignment, where appropriate and needed

  • Identify opportunities to develop and implement new policies and procedures, including rationalization of legacy policies and procedures

  • Actively engage in and support the use of e‑procurement strategy, methodology and deployment

  • Prepare high quality papers and presentations for use with internal and external stakeholders and/or teams as required

  • Apply ethical company standards and ensure Global Procurement policy is applied at all times

Ability to Manage the Sourcing Process

  • Develop category plan with the ability to provide visibility such as supplier summaries, stakeholder engagement plans, contract summaries, and market insights that lead to both short and long‑term strategies

  • Ability to negotiate and have proven strategies within areas of corporate spend

  • Lead development and execution of all sourcing‑related functions: performing due diligence and assessment of prospective suppliers, executing RFPs/bids, negotiating contracts and ensuring effective transition to operations during implementation

  • Partner with CIO’s and the business to drive both immediate and sustained benefits to JLL Corporate

  • Bring strategic thought leadership to identify additional cost and operational efficiencies. Individual must be able to consider bigger picture goals and scenarios. The individual has to be able to clearly articulate and advise senior members of JLL on decisions that could impact business line performance

  • Proactively manage internal stakeholder expectations and escalation at appropriate times

  • Savings – working with sourcing managers and key suppliers, ensure that savings initiatives ideas are being driven to maximize savings impacts

  • Ensure that the savings tracker across country is kept up‑to‑date for the category so that we can demonstrate value add to our internal stakeholders

  • Conduct Preferred Supplier performance review meetings, manage supplier scorecards, contract compliance and service obligations

  • Subject matter expert for category and considered to be the channel of choice within JLL

Sound like you? To apply you need to have:

  • Excellent Inter‑personal skills, Organization skills, Strong gravitas and influencing skills with senior business leaders

  • Ability work on a global scale and across different regions. This includes the ability to meet and align category plans with global vertical stakeholders

  • Excellent communication skills – oral and written

  • Proven ability to facilitate strategic supplier relationships and work with senior business executives and across procurement leadership

  • Collaborative and influencing style with a focus on team work

  • Proven ability to deliver results in challenging environments

  • Expertise in sourcing with demonstrated ability to manage change

  • Ability to sell and present initiatives and/or new ideas

  • Experience in sourcing indirect corporate services and products

  • Excellent PC skills, proficient in MS applications with excellent ability to work with large amounts of data and build reports

  • Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) from four‑year college university

  • Minimum 7 years of strategic sourcing experience (majority within IT and technology)

  • CPSM certification preferred

  • MBA preferred

Location

  • Role to be based in North America (USA or Canada)

  • As part of the role, individuals must have the flexibility to deal with projects in different time zones and manage their time accordingly

What you can expect from us

You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like‑minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.

Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. We’ll offer you a competitive salary and benefits package.

description:
Programa Talento Inovação – IEL Paraná

O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Projeto: Futuro da Beleza – Vaga afirmativa

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).

Sobre a Oportunidade – Grupo Boticário

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I. Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Formação Acadêmica

Mestre em Engenharia, Biotecnologia, Química, Farmácia, Analytics, Data Science, Estratégia ou Marketing.

Idioma

Inglês – Nível avançado (leitura).

Principais Atividades

  • Realizar buscas em bases de dados já pré-definidas na metodologia, mapear e consolidar as tecnologias levantadas.
  • Fazer a análise crítica dos dados obtidos e cruzar com estratégia de inovação do Grupo Boticário.
  • Caracterizar as rotas tecnológicas identificadas de acordo com metodologia pré-definida.
  • Calibrar pesquisa com consumidores e realizar consolidação do material e análise crítica dos resultados.
  • Construir a apresentação do relatório final.

Conhecimento Necessário

  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar os dados obtidos e conectá-los com os relatórios estratégicos obtidos e liderados por outras áreas do Grupo Boticário;
  • Curiosidade e proatividade em busca de informações;
  • Capacidade de síntese e comunicação clara;
  • Interesse em inovação e novas tecnologias;
  • Conhecimento em foresight estratégico;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (Google Sheets);

Conhecimento Desejável

  • Experiência em foresight estratégico na área;
  • Conhecimento da indústria de cosméticos;
  • Desejável experiência em interpretação de escrita científica;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (Looker);
  • Soft Skills: Empatia, Espírito de Equipe, Comunicação;

Benefícios

title: CX Performance Manager
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a CX Performance Manager in our CX Global area in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Portugal.

The team's mission is to drive Customer Experience performance improvement by leveraging analytical insights and hypothesis testing to identify key opportunities. The position has shifted from primarily focusing on problem identification to requiring this person to create action plans and roadmaps to follow through on resolutions. This change adds a layer of communication and senior leadership because the professional will need to convince other areas to invest in resolving the problems, requiring negotiation skills with major stakeholders. The role covers all four Wellhub verticals (user, client, partner, risk) both regionally and globally.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Reporting directly to the CX Insights leader, build Performance team from scratch overviewing customer experience performance globally
  • Act as the point of contact for customer experience performance requests
  • Identify areas of operational improvement on all four Wellhub verticals (user, client, partner, risk) both regionally and globally
  • Apply strong quantitative skills to formulate, test, and validate data-backed hypotheses, ensuring all conclusions are data-supported and translate into clear, actionable strategies.
  • Proactively set action plans to untap new customer experience opportunities; preparing and leading initiatives and its roadmap
  • Manage a broad base of cross-functional stakeholders, both internally and externally, across multiple departments at a global scale
  • Monitor the overall performance of customer experience operations among all business units and countries, reacting to gaps observed via proposing short and long term corrective actions
  • Conduct studies and drive conclusions that will support executives to take operations’ performance decisions
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor's degree in STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)
  • Strong analytical skills, with solid experience on problem solving techniques and hypothesis testing
  • Proved critical thinking with the ability to analyse complex sets of data and derive clear, actionable recommendations
  • Solid stakeholder management, with ability to build and present performance results to executives in a clear and executive way
  • Advanced knowledge of business intelligence tools to work in partnership with the technical team members on conducting robust business analysis that involve exploring data, discussing alternatives and lining up proposals
  • Experience in management or strategic consulting is desirable
  • Advanced English skills (mandatory)

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in project and stakeholder management are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

Accounts Payable & Receivable : Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.

Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations : Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .

Month-End Workbooks : Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.

Financial Reporting : Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).

NetSuite : Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.

Communication and Task Management : Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.

Education : Accounting or Finance degree preferred.

Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.

Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.

Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.

Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.

US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.

Experience working with European entities is a plus.

Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.

Working Equipment to start is required.

Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.

1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.

Full access to TGG University and learning materials.

Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

title: Sr Fullstack Developer IV
description:
Overview

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

We are significantly growing our Engineering and IT teams in Brazil and are focused on finding talent for various financial technology (Fintech) engineering, database, development, and testing teams.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. We anticipate developing future leaders for our teams in Brazil!

Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram.

About This Opportunity

As a full-stack software engineer IV, you will get the opportunity to work on InComm Product Control (IPC) team. In this role, you will focus on creating, enhancing, and redesigning the applications with the most cutting-edge technologies to provide POS-integrated platform, automated decision-making at POR terminals and business intelligence analytic tools. IPC is a specialized division of InComm that provides product lifecycle tracking and returns management solutions for retailers and manufacturers.

Responsibilities

  • Designing, developing, and implementing scalable and robust applications using Java and the Spring framework (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data) and front-end framework like Vue JS.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including stakeholders, QA engineers, and product managers, to analyze issues, define requirements and deliver integrated solutions.
  • Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code, adhering to coding standards and best practices.
  • Creating and performing unit, integration, and system testing to ensure application quality and performance.
  • Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues in existing applications.
  • Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback to peers.
  • Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in the Spring ecosystem and JavaScipt communities.
  • Contributing to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Making technical and team decisions and assuming responsibility for those decisions while keeping management informed.
  • Providing direction, motivating, and supporting a small group of individuals to achieve specific goals.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
  • 7+ years of proven experience in developing Java applications (1.8 and above), specifically with the Spring framework and Spring Boot in enterprise level scalable, distributed and fault tolerant environments.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases including SQL, stored procedures, and data modeling with MS SQL and/or Oracle.
  • Strong understanding of object relational mapping APIs like Hibernate, JPA and/or myBatis.
  • Advanced knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 and Core JavaScript. Proficiency in at least one of modern front-end frameworks like Angular, React, and/or Vue.
  • Practical understanding of developing Restful Microservices Services using Spring boot.
  • Proficient in version control, build management, and issue tracking software (i.e. git, Maven, JIRA)
  • Good working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and/or Windows server.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with containerization technologies and continuous delivery tools (e.g., Docker, Jenkins Pipeline, Kubernetes, Istio, ArgoCD and/or Snyk) is preferred.
  • Experience with SQL Sentry Tool, Dynatrace and/or Splunk is beneficial.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshooting issues.
  • Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment).

A EY é líder global em serviços de Auditoria, Impostos, Transações Corporativas e Consultoria. Quase 35.000 profissionais especializados em atender a indústria financeira em todo o mundo, prestam serviços de auditoria, impostos, transações e assessoria empresarial para bancos, seguradoras e gestoras de patrimônio. No Brasil atuam junto aos principais centros mundiais para compartilhar conhecimento relacionado às tendências e regulamentações atuais e emergentes, a fim de ajudar nossos clientes a resolver questões fundamentais em gestão de riscos, controles internos, estratégia, operações e tecnologia da informação.

Este grupo de profissionais, dinâmico e talentoso, busca neste momento o candidato certo para integrar o time e desenvolver uma carreira sólida e ascendente.

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO), estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro (Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Fintechs, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos). TechEY

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como Cientista de Dados Junior você irá atuar em cliente de grande porte, com oportunidade de crescimento em frentes diversas na área de dados voltados para o segmento financeiro. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar pronto/a para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e as comunidades que nos apoiam.

Poderá atuar diretamente com as tecnologias mais avançadas de IA Generativa e LLMs (como GPT, LLaMA e Mistral). Ambiente inovador, com forte incentivo à pesquisa aplicada e experimentação em IA. Terá oportunidade de participar do desenvolvimento de soluções reais e escaláveis. Cultura colaborativa e times multidisciplinares. Possibilidade de crescimento acelerado e envolvimento em projetos estratégicos de alto impacto.

Por que você?

Se você é apaixonado(a) por dados, colaboração e tem as seguintes qualificações, queremos você em nossa equipe:

  • Formação completa nas áreas de Tecnologia, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Administração, Engenharias e ou correlatas;
  • Ampla experiência em Python, especialmente para aplicações de IA. Domínio de frameworks de LLMs (ex: Transformers, HuggingFace, LangChain, OpenAI API);
  • Proficiência com pipelines de dados, ETL, Apache NiFi, Apache Kafka. Prática com versionamento de código (ex: Git), testes automatizados e programação orientada a objetos;
  • Vivência com integração entre sistemas via APIs ou mensagens. Prompt engineering e fine-tuning de modelos;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para leitura técnica e ferramentas.

Desejável - Serão considerados diferenciais:

  • Experiência prática em projetos de IA ou Data Science, preferencialmente em empresas do setor financeiro, como bancos e seguradoras, tecnologia, consultorias ou startups;
  • Atuação em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e participação em comunidades ou projetos open source de IA.
  • Familiaridade com publicações, artigos, ou apresentações em eventos de tecnologia.
  • Experiência prévia com validação humana de modelos (human-in-the-loop).
  • Certificações em Data Science (ex: IBM Data Science, AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer), ou cursos reconhecidos em Machine Learning, IA ou Big Data.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Como Cientista de Dados você atuará na evolução de modelos baseados em LLMs, desde o prompt engineering até a implantação em produção;
  • Será responsável por criar, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados utilizando ferramentas de mercado (NiFi, Kafka);
  • Irá automatizar processos de ETL e integração entre sistemas;
  • Irá garantir a qualidade, versionamento e testabilidade das soluções desenvolvidas e atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.

Oportunidade disponível em modelo presencial (com flexibilidade para o remoto) nos escritórios da EY Brasil.

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios .

Quem somos : Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

About the Job
QA Lead is responsible for overseeing the quality assurance function across Tether Data. This role ensures that product releases meet defined quality standards through the development and execution of test strategies, frameworks, and automation. QA Lead works closely with the teams, Dev‑Ops and Product to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.
QA Lead serves as the quality champion within Tether Data and plays a key role in shaping the overall testing culture and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Define and Drive QA Strategy: Establish and continuously refine the overall QA vision, goals, and strategy to align with product and engineering objectives, balancing manual and automated testing approaches.

  • Mentor and Guide QA Engineers: Provide technical and procedural guidance to QA Engineers, fostering skill development in both manual and automation testing. Conduct regular reviews and coaching sessions.

  • Monitor and Report on Quality Metrics: Define and track key QA KPIs (e.g., defect density, test coverage, pass rate, release readiness). Use insights to drive continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate Release Readiness and Risk Assessment: Lead go/no‑go decisions based on test outcomes, quality metrics, and known issues. Communicate quality status and risks clearly to stakeholders.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Evaluate tools, processes, and team performance to identify opportunities for efficiency and quality enhancement. Champion a culture of learning and proactive defect prevention.
  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.
  • 3+ years of proven experience leading QA teams or managing QA processes across multiple projects.
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java, C#).

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients — in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.
What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.
The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.
Combining these values with our conviction makes Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.
Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT.
The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud‑based IT systems and tools.
A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security‑first environments.
The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.
But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever‑changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.
You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast‑moving and highly execution‑oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

About the Role

This role will report to the Director of IT. You will be customer‑facing, and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.
You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open‑source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Do you integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self‑manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The ideal candidate will:
• Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
• Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
• Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
• Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
• Have worked in a remote environment before.
• Taste of What We Provide.

What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. A comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.
Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.
You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process.
Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.

Here at Power Digital, we are hyper‑focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first‑party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A—putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team—of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists—challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn’t guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A day in the life: A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics— from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self‑starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem‑solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8‑10 clients
  • Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high‑performing creative assets
  • Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
  • Maintaining client communications and sentiment
  • Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals
  • Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes
  • Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform
  • Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
  • Writes strategic consumer‑centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
  • Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
  • Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
  • Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
  • Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
  • Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
  • Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital’s Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)
  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps
  • Understanding of best practices for performance‑driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
  • Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post‑production teams to deliver best possible creative output
  • Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • 5% or lower client churn
  • Maintain $22,000 RPE

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends and insights and inform the creative roadmap.

  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.

  • Executar atividade de coordenação do cuidado, identificando situações com necessidade de encaminhamento à equipe de segunda opinião médica, comunicando-se eficientemente com os pacientes e sendo o interlocutor do caso ao gerente de segunda opinião médica.

  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.

No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.


Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.


Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).


Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades.


A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.


Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.


Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.


Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

Job description

Sobre a Clicksign

Estamos em busca de um(a) Data Analyst para atuar como referência analítica da Value Stream de Aquisição e Ativação , unindo rigor técnico e visão de negócio para escalar receita de novos clientes e aumentar a conversão e engajamento inicial.

Será responsável por traduzir dados em estratégias de crescimento previsível, apoiar decisões de marketing e produto e garantir que os novos clientes avancem com sucesso na jornada de ativação.

Esse papel exige perfil híbrido entre marketing analytics e produto analytics, com alta capacidade de transformar dados em narrativas acionáveis para times executivos e squads.

Main responsibilities

  • Mapear, mensurar e otimizar o funil completo de aquisição (leads → trial → subscription → ativação);

  • Conduzir análises de comportamento de trial e ativação (cohorts, time-to-convert, first value moment, early churn);
  • Apoiar na avaliação de performance de campanhas, canais e ICPs;
  • Produzir relatórios executivos e narrativas de performance para comitês estratégicos e diretoria;
  • Construir dashboards e métricas padronizadas (Leads, Conversão, Ticket Médio, Early Churn, NMRR);
  • Apoiar na evolução da jornada inicial, priorizando testes e insights que aumentem engajamento nos primeiros 90 dias;
  • Garantir qualidade e consistência das métricas, em parceria com Analytics Engineering e Data Engineering;
  • Disseminar práticas data-driven dentro da VS, formando stakeholders mais autônomos e conscientes de métricas.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em análises de funil, experimentação e growth analytics;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em estatística descritiva e inferencial (testes de hipótese, causalidade, regressão, cohort analysis);
  • Experiência prática com SQL e linguagens de análise (Python ou R);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de BI (QuickSight, Looker, Metabase, Tableau, etc.);
  • Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Habilidade de traduzir resultados técnicos em recomendações de negócio para públicos não técnicos;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de influência e visão integrada entre marketing e produto;
  • Proatividade para propor hipóteses e conduzir análises ponta a ponta, com senso de urgência e ownership.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em Marketing Analytics, Growth ou Produto;
  • Vivência em ambientes SaaS ou negócios de recorrência;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de tracking e experimentação (ex: PostHog, Segment, Amplitude, GA4);
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de propensão à conversão ou ativação (logistic regression, random forest, etc.);
  • Experiência com A/B testing e métodos causais (Diff-in-Diff, Uplift Modeling, PSM);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e automação (HubSpot, RD, Salesforce, etc.);

Job Description

Visa Case Investigation and Enforcement (CIE) works with issuers, acquirers, processors and merchants worldwide to develop and deliver the support model for Visa Inc. This includes day-to-day operations and product support, back office support and customer performance reporting, including Rules Management function which supports the structural foundation of the Visa Payments network.

Rules & Compliance team works to ensure the safety, security and integrity of the payment system and to support Visa clients in the development of their electronic payments business. Specifically, team establishes and enforces common interoperable rules and standards for our products and services by which clients must operate their Visa programs.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.

Qualifications

This is an operational position responsible for supporting the Notification Process by initiating and monitoring notification notices in alignment with the regulatory and strategic compliance objectives of Visa and its Clients. These objectives are defined by the Visa Charter Documents, Visa Core Rules & Product and Service Rules, associated Supplemental Requirements, the Visa do Brasil Regulamento (here referred to as Visa Rules), as well as the various laws governing the Payment System in Brazil.

The jobholder operates independently under moderate supervision and will influence other functions regarding practices, policies, and procedures related to rule compliance. The role is primarily accountable for supporting the team’s initiatives and tasks across the LAC region, with a focus on the Brazilian market, addressing all inquiries, potential violations, and other matters related to the Visa Rules. The position will manage internal and external relationships within the context of the Notification Process, escalating matters to Visa Rules senior management where appropriate, with the objective of minimizing brand and reputational risk to the Visa enterprise.

The jobholder will work on smaller projects under moderate supervision. While compliance issues are typically not highly complex, they may require an understanding of other operational areas and all Visa Processing Requirements. The role will engage with Visa staff and Clients to facilitate and ensure compliance with the Visa Rules.

  • Utilização da linguagem R é desejável;

  • Boa redação em português;
  • Domínio avançado do idioma inglês;
  • Conhecimento do idioma alemão é um diferencial;
  • Habilidade para sistematização e indexação de informações;
  • Participação em grupo de pesquisa é desejável;
  • Facilidade no relacionamento com especialistas e para apresentação a públicos.

Atividades

  • Estabelecer interlocução com as equipes dos parceiros alemães para ter acesso aos dados coletados pelos dispositivos;
  • Analisar a estrutura dos dados coletados pelos dispositivos;

  • Colaborar com o time alemão nas análises de dados preliminares coletados em Münster, desenvolvendo o conjunto de indicadores delineado com os parceiros;
  • Analisar os dados coletados em São Paulo, desenvolvendo o conjunto de indicadores delineado com os parceiros e nos workshops participativos;
  • Apoio na estruturação e realização de workshops realizados em São Paulo, tendo em vista a estrutura de dados disponíveis, as possíveis perguntas de exploração pré-analíticas e as interpretações dos resultados;

Role Overview

As a Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist , you will be a senior-level expert driving full-funnel paid social media strategies to fuel our clients’ growth. You’ll execute and optimize campaigns across major social platforms, ensuring they meet and exceed performance targets while aligning with broader marketing initiatives. With your strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate creative, retention, and conversion rate optimization efforts into cohesive campaigns.

This role offers a clear path to leadership – you’ll work alongside our Paid Media Manager (PMM) to accomplish key business objectives and initiatives, positioning yourself for future growth into roles like Paid Media Manager. If you’re a data-savvy, innovative marketer passionate about leveraging AI and rapid experimentation to scale DTC brands, this opportunity is your next big challenge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Paid Social Campaign Execution & Optimization: Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns across platforms (e.g., Facebook/Instagram, TikTok) to drive customer acquisition and retention. Implement audience segmentation, targeting, messaging, and bidding strategies, continuously A/B testing creatives and audience approaches to maximize engagement and conversions. Work closely with creative, email/SMS, conversion rate optimization, SEO, and content teams to integrate campaign efforts and share insights. Ensure consistent messaging and leverage cross-channel learnings to improve marketing efficiency and customer lifetime value.
  • Data Analysis & KPI Management: Leverage advanced analytics platforms and AI-driven tools to monitor campaign performance and inform optimizations. Track and analyze key metrics – including return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), marketing efficiency ratio (MER), click-through rate (CTR), average order value (AOV), and CAC-to-LTV ratio – adjusting budgets and strategy to exceed targets. Use data-driven insights to make timely optimizations that improve ROI and scale results.
  • Insightful Reporting & Presentations: Compile and present detailed performance reports that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Communicate the story behind the numbers, enabling informed decision-making and demonstrating the value of our paid social efforts.

Participate in occasional client calls or meetings to provide updates, explain campaign performance, and answer questions with professionalism and clarity. Help maintain transparent, trusting relationships by ensuring clients understand campaign progress and value.
  • Strategic Initiative Execution: Partner with the PMM to execute key business initiatives and special projects in paid media. Translate high-level objectives into actionable campaign plans and take ownership of their successful implementation. Proactively contribute ideas and optimizations that drive business goals, demonstrating leadership potential and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • Proactive & Adaptable: You’re always ahead of the curve, staying on top of platform changes and anticipating challenges before they arise. You pivot with agility, turning potential obstacles into growth opportunities

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field (required) .
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience in paid social (required) , with a deep understanding of paid acquisition and media buying strategies. Proven ability to scale campaigns, manage substantial budgets, and consistently meet or exceed key performance targets.
  • Technical Skills: Highly knowledgeable in bidding and targeting automation tools; proficient in Google Analytics and other ad management/testing platforms.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent project management and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to structure complex, multi-stakeholder projects effectively. Strong written and verbal communication skills for both client-facing and internal collaboration.
  • Performance Culture: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and effective time-management.

Compensation & Benefits

Ready to Shape the Future of Paid Acquisition & Paid Social — And Revolutionize with AI?

Join WKND as a Senior Paid Social Acquisition Specialist and become a pivotal force behind high-performing, AI-enhanced campaigns for top DTC brands. You won’t just execute ads—you’ll help shape strategy, pioneer new approaches in paid social, and contribute to our bold shift toward an AI-driven SaaS model.

If you’re passionate about delivering transformative outcomes, driving exponential growth, and advancing your career in a cutting-edge environment, WKND is where you belong .

description:

Você acredita que a educação melhora o mundo? Você quer participar de uma rede de networking de mais de 4 mil executivos e 1.000 estudantes onde, além de gerar valor para sua carreira, você também contribui para educação e combate à fome? Se a resposta é sim, venha conosco!

A PUC angels (Associação Anjos da PUC) é uma associação sem fins lucrativos que busca, por meio da educação, aprimorar o ecossistema de empreendedorismo e empregabilidade no Brasil. Acreditamos que o primeiro empreendimento de uma pessoa é sua carreira profissional. Hoje, contamos com mais de 20 colaboradores diretos e uma rede de mais de 4.000 executivos e 1.000 estudantes no Programa Anjo, que também pode incluir você – com oportunidades para atuar como mentor, executivo, empreendedor e/ou investidor.

Formato do Comitê de ESG PUC angels

O cargo é voluntário e remoto, para atuar como Membro do Comitê de ESG (com possibilidade de progressão para a posição de Líder Anjo de ESG para empresas e startups interessadas). Os membros contribuem com o ecossistema da PUC angels, auxiliando fundadores de startups, executivos e estudantes no desenvolvimento e aplicação de conhecimentos, além de participar de iniciativas e comissões conforme a demanda. Os Líderes Anjo podem liderar as Iniciativas e Comissões, conforme submetem o tema e o mesmo é aprovado pelo Presidente do Comitê.

Papéis: Membro Executivo vs. Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG

Como Membro, você participa de reuniões gerais e abertas, assim como eventos, podendo sugerir temas para revisão, além de divulgar seu título de Membro do Comitê de em seu LinkedIn. Como Líder Anjo, terá a oportunidade de liderar Comissões e Iniciativas, assumir diretorias do comitê, submeter temas para avaliação da Presidência, e poderá concorrer à liderança do Comitê, participando de eventos exclusivos para Líder Anjos e outros associados.

Qualificações:

  • Interesse e paixão pelo tema do Comitê de ESG
  • Capacidade de pensar estrategicamente e aplicar conhecimentos na prática
  • Paixão por contribuir para a sociedade por meio da educação
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento
  • Habilidade de trabalho remoto e proativo
  • Envolvimento com o tema do comitê
  • Proficiência em português (inglês e espanhol são diferenciais pois a PUC angels está expandindo)
  • Paciência e habilidade para ensinar e motivar

Por que Participar como Membro ou Líder Anjo no Comitê de ESG da PUC angels?

  • Ganhe visibilidade no mercado, destacando-se como um Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG da PUC angels
  • Tenha impacto direto no ecossistema de inovação e mudanças de mercado, assumindo uma posição de liderança
  • Acrescente experiência e o título de Membro Executivo /Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG da PUC angels ao seu perfil profissional
  • Expanda seu networking com mais de 4.000 executivos, 1.000 alunos e empreendedores
  • Participe como mentor, conselheiro, investidor e/ou empreendedor dentro do ecossistema de networking da PUC angels
  • Escolha as frentes em que deseja atuar ou explore todas as oportunidades que oferecemos

Atividades do Comitê

  • Reuniões online: Sessões periódicas sobre temas de mercado e painéis com profissionais de destaque
  • Produção de artigos: Elaboração de conteúdos sobre novidades e dados de mercado
  • Regulamentações: Participação em grupos para regulamentação de iniciativas, com interação direta com executivos, empresas, governo e outras associações via PUC angels

Oportunidades Complementares

  • Possibilidade de investir em projetos já existentes
  • Sessões de pitch (online e presenciais), eventos de aceleração e parcerias estratégicas
  • Atuação como Mentor ou Conselheira Anjo para startups e estudantes

Networking e Eventos

  • Acesso a grupos exclusivos no WhatsApp e LinkedIn
  • Participação em eventos temáticos presenciais e online promovidos pela PUC angels e Comitês, em locais de destaque como a Tuca da PUC SP, Inovabra e FIEP

Objetivo dos Comitês PUC angels

Promover a evolução e integração dos mercados em que atua através do conhecimento e networking, atuando, quando necessário, na regulamentação necessária para que cada mercado cresça de forma sustentável.

Missão PUC angels

Melhorar o mundo através da educação e do combate à fome.

Objetivo do Comitê de ESG PUC angels

Promover o empreendedorismo de ESG, networking e inovação, fortalecendo empresas, ampliando a empregabilidade e gerando valor para todas as pessoas envolvidas.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Facilities Manager is responsible for overseeing the maintenance, repair, and operational efficiency of all physical assets across our quick-service restaurant locations. This role ensures that our facilities are safe, compliant with regulations, and optimized to support a positive customer and employee experience. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong organizational skills and a passion for operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facility Maintenance : Oversee and coordinate routine maintenance, repairs, and inspections of restaurant facilities, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and kitchen equipment.
  • Vendor Management : Negotiate and manage contracts with external vendors for maintenance, cleaning, and repair services, ensuring cost-effectiveness and timely service delivery.
  • Compliance and Safety : Ensure all locations comply with health, safety, and sanitation regulations, including OSHA, FDA, and local health department standards. Conduct regular audits to maintain compliance.
  • Budget Management : Manage the facilities budget, tracking expenses and identifying cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality or safety.
  • Emergency Response : Respond promptly to facility-related emergencies, such as equipment failures or structural issues, to minimize downtime and maintain operational continuity.
  • Team Collaboration : Work closely with restaurant managers and support teams to address facility needs, implement improvements, and support brand standards.
  • Preventive Maintenance Programs : Follow and implement preventive maintenance schedules to reduce equipment downtime and extend the lifespan of assets.
  • Project Management : Support facility-related projects, such as renovations, remodels, or new store openings, ensuring timely completion within budget and scope.

Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in facility management, engineering, business administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience : Minimum of 1-3 years of facility management experience, preferably in the quick-service restaurant, retail, or hospitality industry.
  • Technical Skills : Strong knowledge of HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, and electrical systems. Familiarity with kitchen equipment (e.g., fryers, grills, freezers).
  • Certifications : Preferred certifications include Certified Facility Manager (CFM), OSHA 30, or similar credentials in safety or facility management.
  • Soft Skills : Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills. Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Financial Acumen : Experience managing budgets and negotiating vendor contracts.
  • Availability : Willingness to travel to multiple locations and respond to emergencies outside regular business hours.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform physical inspections of facilities, including climbing ladders and accessing confined spaces.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced restaurant environment with exposure to kitchen equipment and varying temperatures.

Beginning as a hot dog cart in New York City’s Madison Square Park, Shake Shack was created by Danny Meyer, Founder and CEO of Union Square Hospitality Group and best-selling author of Setting the Table. title: Staff Ml Engineer (Conversational Ai)
description:
Company Description Yuna's mission is to radically transform the way mental health support is accessed and delivered. By providing 24 / 7 instant and private support at the push of a button, we aim to address the significant gaps in mental health care accessibility. In a system where waiting times for therapists can reach up to 48 days and many people can't even afford care, Yuna is the answer to immediate mental health support needs.

We’re growing quickly, and every person who joins us plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of mental health technology.

Position Overview

You’ll own Yuna’s core conversational intelligence (i.e. spanning retrieval, memory, safety, evaluation, and post-training). You’ll ship user-visible improvements quickly while raising the bar on empathy, reliability, and guardrails. This is a hands-on staff-level role : equal parts research-to-production and platform thinking.

What you’ll do

Lead the end-to-end model lifecycle of Yuna’s conversational AI : problem framing → data curation → modeling / fine-tuning / post-training → evals → rollout → monitoring

Work closely with clinical psychologists (both internal and external to Yuna), ensuring the efficacy of Yuna’s conversational AI

Design agentic flows (tool use, planning, multi-turn memory) and safe retrieval for mental-health use cases

Build and own the evaluation flywheel : benchmarks, judge models, rubrics for conversational quality, ability to help, safety

Implement alignment & safety layers (e.g., self-harm detection, red-teaming, refusal strategies, escalation paths) tuned to clinical guidelines

Optimize for latency, cost, and quality

Partner tightly with product, sales, and users to scope new features and

Establish LLMOps: datasets, prompts / checkpoints / versioning, observability, drift monitoring, and incident response for model quality

What you’ll bring

5+ years in ML / AI with 3+ shipping LLM / NLP systems in production

Deep skill in Python and modern deep learning stacks (PyTorch / JAX / TensorFlow), retrieval / RAG, embeddings, reranking, and long-context summarization

Experience building agentic systems (tool calling, decomposition, memory) and rigorous eval harnesses (offline + online)

Strong product sense; you care about user outcomes, not just model metrics

Comfort working with ambiguity and creating systems 0 to 1

Location: Remote (work from anywhere, with at least 6 hours overlap with PST)

Employment Type: Full Time

What We Offer

Competitive salary (based on experience) + equity options

Remote-first culture with flexibility

A fast-growing, talented, and empathetic team dedicated to transforming mental health care

The opportunity to make a real impact on the world, building cutting-edge AI systems that improve lives every day

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Overview

As a Product Security Engineer at Toradex, you’ll be responsible for the implementation, validation, and maintenance of security features in Toradex’s embedded software stack. That means hands‑on, low‑level work with bootloaders, Linux kernel security features, secure software updates and more.

We aim to make embedded software development easy and approachable, which means that our engineers have to go beyond just feature enablement. Your work will involve making the developer experience of working with low‑level security features as smooth as it possibly can be. You’ll work on systems used in critical industries like healthcare, industrial automation, and robotics.

Responsibilities

  • Security feature enablement: Bring up security features on new hardware. Every new product we release, we strive to have a uniform, straightforward experience for enabling basic hardware security features like secure boot, ARM TrustZone/ OP-TEE , and hardware‑backed encryption.
  • System-level hardening: Toradex maintains Torizon OS, a secure, production‑ready embedded Linux OS. Making sure that security features fit into the whole stack, and that configurations are secure‑by‑default for the most common and supported workflows is a key part of the job. Understanding how everything fits together is a must.
  • Vulnerability management: Monitor upstream CVEs, assess their impact on Toradex products and their likely impact on Toradex customers' products. Apply patches and mitigations. Help draft security advisories and write VEX documents. Work on and maintain internal tooling for vulnerability management.
  • Security testing and automation: Automate test coverage of security features. Familiarity with LAVA or other hardware‑in‑the‑loop embedded testing methodologies and frameworks is a strong plus.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in embedded systems security or adjacent areas (e.g. Linux security engineering)
  • Hands‑on experience with bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), kernel security features, and embedded Linux distributions/build systems (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, buildroot, etc.)
  • Solid C/C++ coding and debugging skills
  • Experience with automating security checks in CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of threat modeling/risk modeling methodologies and how they relate to regulatory and standards compliance is a plus
  • Knowledge of security evaluation and analysis tools like fuzzers and static analysis tools is a plus

What we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self‑development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature‑rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self‑driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Interested in building your career at Toradex? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email.
