title: Security Engineer
description:
Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company.
  • Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
  • We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

We are a remote first environment.

description:
Job description

Você irá exercer um papel de extrema importância no crescimento da doc9 como Lead Product Manager (Coordenador de Produto) .

A doc9 é uma lawtech com marca consolidada no mercado jurídico com seus serviços de marketplace (cálculos, audiências e outras diligências) e que cresce em ritmo exponencial com produtos puramente tecnológicos (SaaS), como o Whom.doc9 e o eHealth.doc9 .

Somos formados por gente inquieta e empreendedora, que valoriza o trabalho em equipe e acredita que o crescimento sustentável se dá a partir de pessoas que amam o que fazem.

Estamos em busca de pessoas engajadas, que tenham brilho no olho e muita vontade de se desenvolver e crescer com a gente.

Main responsibilities

Como Lead Product Manager (Coordenador de Produto) , você será responsável por coordenar as frentes de produto e orquestrar o funcionamento operacional e tático de uma tribo, reportando-se diretamente ao Group Product Manager (GPM), garantindo clareza, ritmo e previsibilidade nas entregas .

Esse papel é crítico para consolidar a operação e maturidade da tribo , conectando estratégia, execução e resultado, traduzindo direções estratégicas em planos práticos e viáveis, apoiando os POs e sendo o elo diário com tecnologia, CX, Suporte e Comercial.

Entre suas principais responsabilidades estarão:

  • Propor roadmaps e direcionamentos de produto, em alinhamento com o GPM e stakeholders, participando da construção estratégica, mas com foco na execução, consolidação e adaptação junto aos POs.
  • Traduzir as diretrizes estratégicas do GPM em planos táticos claros e operacionais, assegurando coerência entre squads e priorizações.
  • Apoiar e coordenar os Product Owners, garantindo consistência entre suas frentes, qualidade nas definições e alinhamento de entregas.
  • Conduzir alinhamentos táticos e operacionais com o time e com as squads, para tratar dependências, bloqueios, riscos e status de execução.
  • Atuar lado a lado com o Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, alinhando prioridades, negociando prazos e acompanhando a execução técnica e seus impactos.
  • Consolidar resultados, bloqueios e urgências da tribo, sintetizando informações em relatórios e planos de ação acionáveis para o GPM e stakeholders.
  • Ser ponto focal de interface com as áreas de Tecnologia, CX, Suporte e Comercial, garantindo fluxo de informação, gestão de dependências e comunicação eficaz entre as frentes.
  • Identificar riscos, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria, propondo ajustes e acompanhando a implementação de soluções.
  • Garantir que as squads estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do quarter, com foco em previsibilidade e entregas consistentes.
  • Apoiar o GPM na análise de resultados, acompanhamento de indicadores e revisões de progresso.

Requirements and skills

Para ser o nosso novo talento você precisa ter:

  • Perfil de liderança intermediária e coordenador de execução , com foco em ritmo, clareza e entrega.
  • Capacidade de estruturar caminhos e decisões com espírito colaborativo e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Organização e visão sistêmica para conectar múltiplas frentes de produto sem perder o foco em resultado.
  • Habilidade de e síntese , transformando informações técnicas em relatórios executivos claros.
  • Energia e proatividade para traduzir estratégia em ação , promovendo alinhamento e confiança no time.
  • Vontade genuína de crescer como liderança de produto , sendo referência de execução e consistência.
  • Perfil colaborativo, organizado e orientado a resultados , com postura de liderança de serviço.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma transversal com Tecnologia, CX, Suporte e Comercial, garantindo coesão e velocidade.
  • Conhecimento em métodos ágeis e familiaridade com rotinas de squads multidisciplinares.
  • Alta capacidade de analisar dados de produto e extrair insights acionáveis.
  • Interesse em construir ambientes colaborativos e times de alta performance.

E os seguintes conhecimentos e experiências:

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager ou Product Lead , preferencialmente em produtos SaaS B2B complexos, de pelo menos 4 anos.
  • Vivência em coordenação ou liderança de POs , com histórico de desenvolvimento de pessoas e gestão de entregas.
  • Capacidade de propor direções e roadmaps , equilibrando estratégia e execução sob validação da liderança.
  • Experiência prática em discovery, priorização e análise de métricas de produto.
  • Domínio de planejamento tático e gestão de dependências entre squads .
  • Experiência em gestão de portfólio e governança de produto .
  • Vivência em crescimento e expansão de produtos digitais consolidados.
  • Experiência com planejamento trimestral (QBRs), acompanhamento de OKRs e métricas estratégicas.
  • Capacidade de planejar e direcionar pesquisas e análises para evolução de produtos .

Ferramentas, Tecnologias e Linguagens Necessárias:

  • Gestão de backlog e priorização: Jira, Linear ou ClickUp.
  • Mapeamento e documentação colaborativa: Miro, FigJam ou Notion.
  • Métricas e acompanhamento de produto: Metabase, GA4, Amplitude ou Looker.
  • Frameworks de apoio: OKRs, PM Canvas, GIST, RICE, Opportunity Solution Tree, CIRCLES, JTBD.

We’re seeking a highly motivated, team-oriented Data Lead to drive data strategy and execution across a best-in-class portfolio of data products. In this role, you’ll report to our Head of Data and split your time between owning challenging analytical work and guiding a team of data analysts to build and deliver top-tier data products.

Those with strong analytical skills who are excited to lead teams, build and optimize data workflows, and partner cross-functionally to shape and execute on product strategy are encouraged to apply.

As a Data Lead, You Will

  • Own data strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-impact data products for investors, driving product success through a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency and partnering closely with research and commercial leaders to set and hit ambitious targets
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for quality, speed, and innovation while coaching, empowering, and inspiring your team to do their best work.

Preferred

What We Offer

Remote work

Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.

Lazer Commerce

Lazer Commerce is a specialized team within Lazer focused on crafting scalable, high‑performing commerce experiences across the Shopify ecosystem. We partner with forward‑thinking brands and agencies to design and implement custom storefronts, headless architectures, and robust backend integrations. From theme development to complex ERP and OMS workflows, our engineers bring deep expertise in Shopify, modern frameworks, and commerce infrastructure to help clients launch, scale, and optimize their digital retail experiences.

The Roles

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Shopify, to join our remote team. We hire across multiple technical tracks depending on your strengths and focus area.

Front‑End Engineer (Shopify)

  • Build custom Shopify storefronts and themes using Liquid, React, and modern frameworks like Next.js and Remix.
  • Translate design mockups and business requirements into high‑quality, accessible, and scalable code.
  • Implement reusable components, UI logic, and performance optimization best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with designers and backend engineers on headless Shopify builds.
  • Stay up to date with the latest Shopify front‑end updates and trends.

You Bring

  • Strong experience in Liquid and custom theme development.
  • Proficiency in React, Next.js, Remix, and TypeScript.
  • Familiarity with Shopify Storefront API and headless commerce.
  • Passion for creating accessible, fast, and beautiful web experiences.

Back‑End Engineer (Shopify Apps & Extensions)

  • Design and build Shopify apps (public/private) and backend APIs using Node.js, Remix, or Next.js.
  • Implement Shopify Functions, custom checkout logic, and performance optimizations.
  • Work with MongoDB, Supabase, and related databases for data persistence.
  • Integrate with third‑party APIs, tools, and Shopify Admin/Storefront APIs.
  • Collaborate with front‑end engineers and product teams on headless commerce builds.

You Bring

  • Strong experience developing within the Shopify ecosystem.
  • Hands‑on experience with Node.js, Remix, Next.js, and Shopify Functions.
  • Knowledge of API authentication, webhooks, and scalable architectures.
  • Understanding of deployment pipelines and Git‑based workflows.

Back‑End Engineer (Integrations & Systems Architecture)

You’ll focus on building robust, scalable integrations between Shopify and enterprise systems (ERP, OMS, CMS).

  • Develop and maintain backend integrations for Shopify with systems like NetSuite, D365, Manhattan, Contentful, Strapi, and Sanity.
  • Handle data migrations and manage ETL processes between legacy and Shopify systems.
  • Build services using Node.js, Remix, Next.js, and PostgreSQL.
  • Leverage iPaaS tools (Celigo, MuleSoft, Workato) for complex integrations.
  • Collaborate with client teams to ensure secure, reliable, and high‑performance data flows.

You Bring

  • Proven experience designing scalable Shopify integrations.
  • Deep understanding of API data mapping, authentication, and migration.
  • Strong skills in PostgreSQL, ETL, and cloud deployment.
  • Experience collaborating with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Full‑Stack Engineer (Shopify)

You’ll combine front‑end and back‑end expertise to design, develop, and maintain full Shopify solutions.

  • Build and maintain full Shopify applications and headless storefronts.
  • Work directly with clients to define technical needs and design architecture.
  • Implement backend services, APIs, and front‑end UI with Next.js, Remix, React, and TypeScript.
  • Handle database design, migrations, and integrations (PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM).
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members.

You Bring

  • Comprehensive experience across Shopify’s Admin API, Storefront API, and Theme App Extensions.
  • Strong technical skills in React, Next.js, Remix, and TypeScript.
  • Solid database and API integration background.
  • Excellent problem‑solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.

About the Role

We’re seeking a highly motivated, team-oriented Data Lead to drive data strategy and execution across a best-in-class portfolio of data products. In this role, you’ll report to our Head of Data and split your time between owning challenging analytical work and guiding a team of data analysts to build and deliver top-tier data products.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on ownership, collaboration, and delivering measurable value. Those with strong analytical skills who are excited to lead teams, build and optimize data workflows, and partner cross-functionally to shape and execute on product strategy are encouraged to apply.

  • Own data strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-impact data products for investors, driving product success through a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency and partnering closely with research and commercial leaders to set and hit ambitious targets
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for quality, speed, and innovation while coaching, empowering, and inspiring your team to do their best work.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to help answer investor key questions about the sectors we cover and datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
  • Tackle complex data problems, using your analytical skills to optimize methodologies, test new datasets, and solve data-related problems that require innovative solutions.
  • Drive standardization, simplification, and improvements to our data pipelines and workflows to minimize risk and maximize efficiency and value.
  • Partner cross-functionally with other teams including Research and Engineering to uncover and execute on opportunities to further drive customer value and optimize our processes and pipelines.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, forecasting, or business intelligence, including 1-2 years in a management or lead capacity.

  • You excel at approaching complex problems logically and decisively, and take pride in implementing scalable solutions.
  • You have a strong ownership and entrepreneurial mentality and are enthusiastic about working with others to make a big impact.

Preferred

What We Offer

Remote work

Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
